Backend: POST /api/auth/login-with-jwt body { email, jwt }
Response: { access_token, refresh_token, user }

projectId: from env, e.g., VITE_APPWRITE_PROJECT_ID

success:

+import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
+import { useSearchParams, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
+import { AppwriteAuthService } from '@/lib/appwriteAuth';
+
+export default function VerifyEmail() {
+  const [params] = useSearchParams();
+  const nav = useNavigate();
+  const [msg, setMsg] = useState('Verifying...');
+
+  useEffect(() => {
+    const userId = params.get('userId');
+    const secret = params.get('secret');
+    if (!userId || !secret) {
+      setMsg('Missing userId or secret');
+      return;
+    }
+
+    AppwriteAuthService.verifyEmail(userId, secret)
+      .then(() => setMsg('Email verified successfully.'))
+      .catch(() => setMsg('Verification failed'));
+  }, [params]);
+
+  return (
+    <div className="max-w-md mx-auto p-6 text-center">
+      <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold mb-2">Verify Email</h1>
+      <p className="mb-4">{msg}</p>
+      <button className="bg-blue-600 text-white px-4 py-2 rounded" onClick={() => nav('/auth')}>
+        Go to login
+      </button>
+    </div>
+  );
+}

### Done. Your frontend now matches the Appwrite + backend JWT contract you described.

- Appwrite SDK reads env:
  - VITE_APPWRITE_ENDPOINT
  - VITE_APPWRITE_PROJECT_ID
  - VITE_API_URL (backend base, e.g., https://nest.arzansite.com/api)

- Signup flow wired:
  - Appwrite `account.create(email, password, name)`
  - Appwrite `account.createVerification(redirectUrl)` with redirect to `/auth/verify`
  - Page `GET /auth/verify?userId=<id>&secret=<secret>` calls `account.updateVerification(userId, secret)` and then navigates to login

- Login flow wired:
  - Appwrite email session
  - Appwrite `account.createJWT()` → `{ jwt }`
  - Backend `POST /auth/login-with-jwt` with `{ email, jwt }`
  - Stores `{ access_token, refresh_token }` and uses `Authorization: Bearer <access_token>` for all backend calls

What to set in .env
- VITE_APPWRITE_ENDPOINT=https://YOUR_APPWRITE_HOST/v1
- VITE_APPWRITE_PROJECT_ID=YOUR_PROJECT_ID
- VITE_API_URL=https://nest.arzansite.com/api
- In Appwrite console, whitelist redirect URL: https://arzansite.com/auth/verify

Frontend contract (what the app now does)
- Signup:
  - Calls Appwrite to register and send verification
  - Redirect link goes to `/auth/verify?userId=<id>&secret=<secret>`
- Verify:
  - `account.updateVerification(userId, secret)`
  - On success: navigate to `/auth`
- Login:
  - Appwrite email session + `account.createJWT()`
  - Backend: `POST ${VITE_API_URL}/auth/login-with-jwt` with `{ email, jwt }`
  - Response persisted and used for all subsequent backend calls

Example backend request
```http
POST ${VITE_API_URL}/auth/login-with-jwt
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "email": "user@example.com",
  "jwt": "APPWRITE_SESSION_JWT"
}
```

Success response (expected)
```json
{
  "access_token": "JWT",
  "refresh_token": "JWT",
  "user": { "id": "appwriteId", "email": "user@example.com" }
}
```

Routes
- Verify page: `/auth/verify` and `/auth/verify-email` both supported
- After verify: goes to `/auth`

- Removed all Supabase usage and files; replaced with Appwrite + backend.
- Updated remaining components to use `apiClient` and existing services.

What I changed:
- Deleted `src/integrations/supabase/client.ts` and `src/integrations/supabase/types.ts`.
- Converted Supabase-dependent pages/components:
  - `src/pages/ResetPassword.tsx`: dropped Supabase code-exchange flow; uses backend `resetPassword(token, newPassword)` only.
  - `src/components/dashboard/EmailManager.tsx`: replaced Supabase queries and function calls with:
    - `apiClient.getEmailLogs()` and a local stats calculation.
    - `apiClient.sendEmail()` for test email.
  - `src/components/dashboard/AdminWalletManager.tsx`: removed Supabase import, fixed types.
  - `src/components/wizard/OrderSubmissionStep.tsx`: already refactored to `apiClient` (confirmed).
  - `src/components/wizard/FinalStepButton.tsx`: already uses `apiClient` (confirmed).
  - `src/components/wizard/StepFive.tsx`: already uses `apiClient` (confirmed).
  - `src/components/wizard/WireframeEditor.tsx`: already uses `apiClient` (confirmed).
  - `src/components/dashboard/CreateOrderDialog.tsx`: replaced Supabase insert with `apiClient.createOrder(...)`.
  - `src/components/dashboard/EditProfileDialog.tsx`: replaced Supabase update with `apiClient.updateProfile(...)`.
  - `src/components/wizard/FileUploadManager.tsx`: replaced Supabase storage and DB calls with backend uploads API:
    - GET `/uploads` for list
    - POST `/uploads` with `FormData` to upload
    - DELETE `/uploads/:id` to remove
    - GET `/uploads/signed-url?path=...` to download
- Removed Supabase directory contents:
  - Deleted `supabase/config.toml-old`, all `supabase/functions/*`, and all `supabase/migrations/*.sql`. The folder is now empty in the IDE snapshot.

Dependencies:
- Removed `@supabase/supabase-js` from `package.json`.

Next steps you may want:
- Ensure backend endpoints exist:
  - GET `/emails/logs`
  - POST `/emails/send`
  - POST `/uploads` (multipart/form-data)
  - GET `/uploads` (list)
  - DELETE `/uploads/:id`
  - GET `/uploads/signed-url?path=...`
  - POST `/domains/check` (used in `StepFive.tsx`)
- Remove Supabase docs if desired: `SUPABASE_*` files.
- Run a clean install so lockfile updates:
  - npm install

- Minimal impact summary:
  - Supabase is fully removed from code.
  - All flows now use Appwrite for auth and your backend for data, email, uploads, wallet, orders, and payments.
